memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: 88‑year‑old man reports persistent worry, muscle tension and fatigue over past months; denies chest pain or palpitations.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.62 m, BMI 25.9 (obese). Regular rhythm, no murmurs. Lung fields clear. Abdomen soft, non‑tender.
IMPRESSION: Generalised anxiety disorder, hypothyroidism (on levothyroxine 50 mcg OD). Elevated BMI warrants lifestyle advice.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start escitalopram 5 mg OD and buspirone 5 mg BD for anxiety. Continue levothyroxine 50 mcg OD. Advise reduced‑calorie diet, walking 30 min daily. Return if worsening anxiety, palpitations, fever >39°C, or black stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Escitalopram 5 mg tablets – take one tablet orally once daily.
Buspirone 5 mg tablets – take one tablet orally twice daily.
Levothyroxine 50 mcg tablets – take one tablet orally once daily, on empty stomach.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: TSH 4.2 mIU/L (ref 0.4‑4.0). Free T4 11.2 pmol/L (ref 9.0‑19.0). Haemoglobin 13.8 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels less anxious but notes mild cold intolerance and weight stable.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 68.5 kg, BMI 26.1 (obese). No thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: Anxiety improving on current regimen. TSH slightly elevated, indicating need for higher levothyroxine dose.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD. Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD and buspirone 5 mg BD. Reinforce low‑salt diet, daily walk. Return if worsening fatigue, heat intolerance, chest pain, or dyspnoea.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Levothyroxine 75 mcg tablets – take one tablet orally once daily, on empty stomach.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine follow‑up; patient reports good sleep, occasional worry.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/80 mmHg, weight 69 kg, BMI 26.3 (obese). No edema.
IMPRESSION: Anxiety stable. Thyroid function improved; lipid and glucose screening due.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar. Give influenza vaccine today (02‑Nov‑2025). Advise maintain weight, continue meds. Return if new chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or melena.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting cholesterol 5.2 mmol/L (ref <5.0). HDL 1.2 mmol/L (ref >1.0). LDL 3.0 mmol/L (ref <3.0). Triglycerides 1.8 mmol/L (ref <1.7). Fasting glucose 6.1 mmol/L (ref 3.9‑5.5).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past month I’ve felt more on edge, waking early with racing thoughts. My appetite is unchanged but I feel tired in the afternoons.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports increased anxiety, early morning awakening, daytime fatigue.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/84 mmHg, weight 69.2 kg, BMI 26.4 (obese). No focal neurologic signs.
IMPRESSION: Worsening generalised anxiety disorder; thyroid stable on current dose.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase escitalopram to 10 mg OD. Continue buspirone 5 mg BD and levothyroxine 75 mcg OD. Counsel on sleep hygiene, limit caffeine. Return if suicidal thoughts, chest pain, fever >39°C, or bleeding.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Escitalopram 10 mg tablets – take one tablet orally once daily.
Buspirone 5 mg tablets – take one tablet orally twice daily.
Levothyroxine 75 mcg tablets – take one tablet orally once daily, on empty stomach.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 15‑Sep‑2026 at 10:30 AM with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review; patient reports anxiety well controlled, good energy.
EXAMINATION: BP 132/78 mmHg, weight 68.8 kg, BMI 26.2 (obese). No thyroid enlargement.
IMPRESSION: Anxiety stable on escitalopram 10 mg OD and buspirone 5 mg BD. TSH trending upward; consider increasing levothyroxine.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, TSH and free T4. Give influenza vaccine today (15‑Sep‑2026). Advise continue diet, activity, meds. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or melena.
